title: Celestial Tranquility

{{Spellpage| | spellname = Celestial Tranquility | spellicon = R | description = Fills your body with celestial power, increasing your attack, attack speed, and armor class for up to 18 secs (3 ticks). Doesn't stack with some other ATK buffs such as [[Grim Aura]], [[Firefist]], and [[Strength of Nature]]. Superficially stacks with spell haste (such as that cast by enchanters and shamans) but only the larger of haste effects will actually apply.
